definitions.leadFraction: whole-body COM projected on the rear-foot-centre → lead-foot-centre line (0 = rear foot, 1 = lead foot)
definitions.headFraction: head joint on the same line
definitions.hipFraction: hip-joint midpoint on the same line
definitions.torsoLeanDeg: hip→shoulder line vs vertical, + = shoulders towards the opponent (skeleton-dependent: Mesh2Motion rest −7.4°, Mixamo rest +3.3°)
